entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states via an Apache-2.0 self-hosted or managed cloud platform. It utilizes temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval to function as an official memory provider for Hermes Agent.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction. This AGPL-3.0 context database archives sessions as editable Markdown files to facilitate efficient memory extraction.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that grants agents persistent long-term memory by distilling sessions into searchable permanent records. It supports local extraction and embedding models, allowing for memory construction from text, code, and conversations without requiring LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This official Hermes memory provider features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from sources including PDFs, images, and code via an MCP server.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: GBrain provides scoped institutional memory for teams, exposing data to agents through MCP on Tailscale tailnets. The system combines keyword retrieval and semantic search with automated background enrichment to enhance agent context.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows through an LLM wrapper designed for disposition-aware response generation. It offers flexible deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or bare metal with support for Python, Node.js, and Go clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho serves as the core FastAPI-based library for building stateful agents and acts as the foundation for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper. It provides Python and TypeScript SDKs to support managed, local, and self-hosted deployment configurations.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this provider manages context trees using git-like version control for committing, branching, and merging markdown files. It features a 5-tier retrieval system that achieves sub-100ms performance across 20 different LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency system uses a single SQLite database to provide sub-millisecond memory access for Hermes Agents. It includes episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os utilizes a seven-layer system including Qdrant vector search and structured facts to manage persistent agent memory. It relies on a Ground Truth hierarchy and local Docker-based infrastructure to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive context harness helps agents manage complex tasks by generating filesystem-first artifacts like playbooks and context bundles. It integrates with MCP clients and self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints through Python and TypeScript surfaces.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes-lcm is a lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools, such as lcm_grep and lcm_recall, to help agents recover specific details from persistent history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from 34 different coding agents to enable natural-language search over months of past activity. It provides millisecond lookups and ensures safety by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for Hermes Agent to enable private cross-session memory persistence. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur functions as a shared memory layer that stores plain-text YAML engrams on local disk for multi-agent systems. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and local embeddings, offering MCP server integration for tool portability.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet is a local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy in benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, and integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema instead of vector databases or embeddings. The five-package family includes an SDK, CLI, and a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It includes primitives for contradiction tracking and a self-directing loop designed to identify and queue knowledge gaps.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis featuring citations, links, and provenance for source-grounded knowledge. It stores data in SQLite with rebuildable Markdown projections and supports portable archives for merging wiki data.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd is an anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses local-first storage via SQLite-vec and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to serve as a single memory owner for Hermes. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver evidence packets to the agent.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to ensure agents only load necessary data. It features local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal to navigate stored information. It features automated indexing for diverse media types and uses edge tags to establish bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated token savings during tool search operations.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context updates for coding agents through hash-checked proposals and receipts. It provides a source-neutral migration path for exporting chat logs and documents across supported agent platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to store and retrieve information. It prioritizes high-value data during context prefetch using a 1-10 importance ranking system and BM25 keyword search.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl file for auditing every prefetch operation. It distinguishes itself by supporting immediate, permanent event deletion to prevent old data from affecting future recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets for x402 payments across multiple blockchain families like EVM and Solana. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing agents to pay for API services directly.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local scripts, runbooks, and MCP configurations to facilitate capability routing. It provides tools for neighbor traversal and search, supporting automatic tool-OKF generation through detached model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-agent continuity by allowing Hermes to read memories generated by other connected agents. It uses native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer to ensure write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories via a required local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for performing semantic searches and grounded Q&A within a codebase.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-node execution modes. It combines HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval methods with MinHash deduplication for long-term data management.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It supports automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information during agent operations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This kit implements a file-based memory loop using a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown storage without a database requirement. It features five slash commands for capture and recall, alongside 'rot' and 'lint' curators that identify stale or conflicting data to propose evidence-cited diffs.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology rooted in TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates implementation planning and spec elicitation while supporting various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime. It exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, and MP4 through a dedicated coding-agent CLI.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured security skills mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and D3FEND. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms and covers 34 distinct security domains.

entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router for protocol skills and adds a dedicated layer for verification and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It offers rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes with optional voice profiles for different professional tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos. It integrates with Hermes and Claude Code, providing a bilingual dashboard to inspect session traces and evolved skills.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state within the project's documentation folder to support Claude Code and other agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,166 professional skills across 35 vocations that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring telemetry or accounts. The MIT-licensed bundles are designed for direct export to assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via specialized slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It manages work, decisions, and evidence through a CLI-driven mechanism kernel.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides agentskills.io-compatible skills and guides for VPS production and automation in Portuguese. It supports integrations for communication platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable interactions with CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams. They are installable through the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. It offers specific prompting guidelines to optimize output across the FLUX 3 video suite.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant skills by linking instructions to specific file lines. It features automated workflows for briefing, creating, testing, and exporting these skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that operates via a Rust binary using four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It maintains local traces and verification journals for every run to ensure transparency.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills installable via a Python client or CLI with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for autonomous execution of long-running tasks, this skill provides real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It includes built-in rollback procedures to facilitate safe recovery during complex multi-step operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS via Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. it features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face, operating autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive scheduling and system design. It stores all data in a local SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.

entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports five programming languages and includes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition, evidence-based verification gates, and systematic investigation protocols. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop failures during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and provides automatic registration for common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to address real exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations and detect state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for developing new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs covering token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy while offering optional incident alerts for Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts via vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding the final optimized file into a README.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, providing direct installation commands for discovered plugins. It integrates with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language and validates them against runtime-specific profiles to prevent configuration drift. It features CI-friendly exit codes and monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to ensure ongoing compatibility.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps and drafting structured improvements. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR on documents via macOS Vision, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed to assist with e-commerce material creation and structured data extraction from images and PDFs.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. it ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This library provides skills and blueprints for lead enrichment, social data access, and automated tasks like newsletter drafting. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and MCP, offering agents access to web scraping and workspace Postgres databases.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is built for compatibility with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties or hosting their own bounty boards. It operates over x402 without requiring accounts or API keys, utilizing user-defined price ceilings and dedicated wallet keys.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills through a hosted MCP server. It enables Hermes Agent to access structured web data across 31 different platforms.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansions with user interests while producing structured analysis that includes core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from major providers like OpenAI and Google. It serves as a specialized distribution layer for users who require reproducible development environments and automated package maintenance.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI interaction by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for mobile agent operations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. The setup supports shell command execution and interactive model configuration through both external providers and local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready CRD workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on high-security deployments by implementing hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing for granular security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and monitor Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative configuration of Hermes Agent deployments, including workspace documents and CLI settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure handling of secrets via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. The platform supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation, enabling the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework organizes specialized agents into a multi-tier structure of researchers, traders, and portfolio managers for financial analysis. It enables backtesting across various LLM providers and data vendors to evaluate fundamental, sentiment, and technical trading strategies.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a centralized Web UI or CLI. It supports multi-agent workflows with integrated memory browsing and can be deployed locally via Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution and Docker for sandboxed environments. Users can monitor agent activity and review code diffs through both TUI and web-based dashboards.

It features specialized detection for HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid API services.

It includes bundled skills for infrastructure tasks such as security auditing, VPS provisioning, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework facilitates the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage agent team delegation and integrates with MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface provides a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent tasks. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure domains. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to handle local tools and communication throughout the automated task lifecycle.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent, referencing Arxiv research for its methodology. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while tracking candidate mutations and frontier progress.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to track performance metrics and GitHub star growth. It utilizes Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize code and scoreboard data.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It eliminates cloud dependencies by running parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server to minimize token usage. It automatically synchronizes the index on every file change to ensure the agent always accesses up-to-date project data.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that monitors token consumption and costs for Hermes Agent and other coding tools. It features a 3D visualization dashboard and a TUI, allowing developers to submit usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other CLI-based coding tools. It generates self-contained HTML reports for session analysis and automatically redacts authentication headers to maintain security.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget tracks real-time token limits and costs for over 38 AI tools by reading the Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and provides detailed usage breakdowns categorized by model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist Hermes Agent in building better user interfaces. It is compatible with any AI provider that supports markdown or general prompting for UI development.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents, such as a CTO and Builder, to manage the full application lifecycle with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills for deployment and monitoring, operating autonomously while requiring founder approval for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes like retro DOS and cyberpunk. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify visual elements such as ASCII art banners, spinners, and colors.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates commerce for Hermes Agent through identity registration with human-readable handles and Solana-based payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to run natively within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing Hermes Agent approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across multiple AI providers.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms like Slack and Telegram to extend the memory capabilities of AI agents.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and finance, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic analysis of agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It integrates into development workflows via GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks, scanning Markdown, JSON, YAML, and Python files to ensure prompt quality.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows developers to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining localized skills and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This setup tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins, providing a zero-cost path to a production-ready environment.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry. It uses zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local configuration changes without cloud dependencies.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project offers a deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It enforces safety by requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions through a system of contracts and offer-previews.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: Hermes-voice adds a fully local, offline voice interface to the agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. The tool features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes enables multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a dedicated circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages and provides specific tools for adding, searching, and deleting agent memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one interface for managing configurations across multiple agentic tools and CLI interfaces, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that enables autonomous multi-step tasks with file access and user approval for agents like Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It supports both built-in and external agents while providing remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard offers unified configuration for ten communication platforms, including WhatsApp and Matrix, across various runtimes like Hermes and DeepSeek Harness. It features a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager with an MCP catalog. It supports a Swarm Mode that utilizes role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for agent coordination.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and custom ACP-compatible registrations. It can be deployed as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container, with native iOS and Android clients for remote connectivity.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application features native window and process management. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check capabilities and a UI that renders LaTeX and Markdown.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It allows for multi-agent profile switching and uses AI-assisted tab scoping to manage prompt context.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: This native SwiftUI iPhone app pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details, file attachments, and private push notifications via an open-source relay.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code alongside custom LLM model routing. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking token latency and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session token burn and estimated API costs for Codex and Claude. It allows users to search prompts and tool calls across local histories and resume supported CLI sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It includes an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically features an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the administration of profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and includes a terminal chat with file attachment support.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a built-in workflow engine and 100 tools for tasks including TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and includes a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations. The interface supports streaming SSE responses and allows for real-time model switching.
